# Frozen shard-service wire codec v1 golden vectors.
#
# THIS FILE IS AN IMMUTABLE COMPATIBILITY ARTIFACT, not a scratch fixture.
# Every byte string here is the on-wire encoding of a named ShardRequest or
# ShardResponse under wire version 1. A gateway and a shard on the same wire
# version must agree on these bytes, forever. If TestShardWireV1GoldenVectors
# (../golden_vectors_test.go) fails, the codec regressed or someone tried to
# make a real mismatch disappear by editing this file. Either is a stop
# condition: review the codec change or the fixture, do not paper over it.
#
# Grammar: one record per line, three whitespace-separated columns.
#   REQUEST  <name> <lowercase-hex-frame>
#   RESPONSE <name> <lowercase-hex-frame>
# The <name> must match a fixture in goldenRequests()/goldenResponses(); the
# test asserts every fixture has a record and every record has a fixture.
# A frame is: tag byte ('Q'=0x51 request, 'R'=0x52 response), a big-endian
# int32 length covering itself but not the tag, then the body, which opens with
# a one-byte wire version (0x01).
#
# To re-author after an intentional, reviewed format change:
#   SHARDSERVICE_EMIT_GOLDEN=1 go test ./shardservice/ -run TestEmitGoldenVectors -v
